“Show more” fits how I’d browse, and the separation between a saved default sort and a temporary sort choice is right. Small, medium, and large text sizes cover what I need.

One important interaction: if only 10 items are currently displayed, **Select all in this view** must still select every bookmark matching the current tab and search, including matches not yet revealed by “Show more.” The item limit should affect display only, not shrink the scope of a whole-view bulk action. Please confirm or correct that before I approve these settings.
